detail.longDescription: 🦇 NEW: A recent # Nature study analyzed # genomes from 103 bat species across all 21 living families, plus physical traits from dozens of species and # fossils . The results place bat origins in # Europe around 65 million years ago, with later spread to # Africa , # Asia , the Americas and # Australia .
